2806356.name: Congregation Ezrath Israel Chabad
2806356.note: COLlive, 31 May 2023 ('Ellenville, New York Is More Than a Vacation Spot'): Rabbi Yakov Raskin, 'Director of Chabad House of Ellenville'; 'He and his wife Chaya Raskin are now directing the Chabad Center which was founded in 2010.' Medium: one secondary source; its chabad.org listing went up 20 Jan 2015, and a separate Ellenville 'Hebrew School' listing (599872) went up in Nov 2007, which this does not explain.

117698.name: Troy Chabad Center
117698.note: Albany Times-Union interview with Rabbi Leible and Elisheva Morrison, on CrownHeights.info, 5 Sept 2016: 'In 1982, they came to Troy where they live in the Chabad House on South Lake Avenue and he is the spiritual leader of Beth Tephilah Synagogue on River Street'; Rabbi Morrison: 'In 1982, the Lubavitcher rebbe sent my wife and me to Troy to run a mikva, a ritual bath, and help the community.' The 1984 Lubavitch list has 'Chabad Lubavitch of Troy, 2306 15th Ave.'

earlier.where: Chabad Lubavitch of Troy, 2306 15th Ave. (the 1984 Lubavitch list, p. 46)

119480.name: Mikvah Chabad
119480.note: Rabbi Leible Morrison (Albany Times-Union, on CrownHeights.info, 5 Sept 2016): 'In 1982, the Lubavitcher rebbe sent my wife and me to Troy to run a mikva, a ritual bath, and help the community.' The year is when the Morrisons began running it; medium, as the mikvah itself may be older. Director: Elisheva Morrison.
